@FIXTURE_DAYS = 90

d_glow_2 = {
	icon = d_glow
	resources = {
		category = orbital_mining_deposits
		produces = {
			trigger = {
				exists = owner
			}
			glow = 1
			glow = 1
		}
	}
	station = shipclass_mining_station
	is_for_colonizable = no
}

d_fixture_blocker = {
	icon = d_fixture_blocker
	category = deposit_cat_blockers
	time = @FIXTURE_DAYS
	resources = {
		cost = {
			glow = 250
		}
	}
	planet_modifier = {
		planet_max_districts_add = -1
	}
	prerequisites = { "tech_fixture_clearing" }
}

d_fixture_rare = {
	category = deposit_cat_rare
	planet_modifier = {
		district_farming_max_add = @FIXTURE_DISTRICTS
	}
	triggered_planet_modifier = {
		potential = {
			exists = owner
			owner = {
				has_technology = tech_fixture_gas
			}
		}
		planet_farmers_glow_produces_add = 0.05
	}
	triggered_planet_modifier = {
		potential = {
			always = no
		}
		planet_farmers_glow_produces_add = 1
	}
}

d_fixture_hab_gas = {
	category = deposit_cat_rare
	triggered_planet_modifier = {
		potential = {
			exists = owner
			owner = {
				is_regular_empire = yes
				has_technology = tech_fixture_gas
			}
		}
		modifier = {
			job_gas_extractor_add = 100
		}
	}
	triggered_planet_modifier = {
		potential = {
			exists = owner
			owner = {
				is_gestalt = yes
				has_technology = tech_fixture_gas
			}
		}
		modifier = {
			job_gas_extraction_drone_add = 100
		}
	}
}

d_fixture_hatchery = {
	category = deposit_cat_blockers
	planet_modifier = {
		planet_max_districts_add = -1
	}
	triggered_planet_modifier = {
		planet_max_districts_add = -4
		habitability_ceil_add = -0.1
		mult = 2
	}
